key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0812
name: select_lowest_slot_and_start
description: Finds which of four stored values is smallest and, when the input value is not below it, writes the register inputs into that slot's record, marks the slot active, and updates the status flags from the status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0832
name: select_slot_if_threshold_met
description: Finds the smallest of four stored values and, only when the input value is at least that minimum, writes the register inputs into the matching slot record and updates the status flags. Otherwise it only clears the busy flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:089A
name: store_slot_record_and_activate
description: Writes register inputs into a slot record addressed by an address register, marks it active, sets its slot index word, and then updates the status flags from the status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:08DE
name: set_slot_index_clear_flag
description: Stores the status byte into the record's index field, then clears one of the per-slot busy flags selected by that status (2, 3, 4, or the first slot otherwise), sets its companion flag, and clears the common busy flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0906
name: release_slot_flags_by_index
description: Clears the busy flag for slot 3 or slot 2, or the first slot for any other index, sets the companion flag, and then clears the common busy flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0920
name: release_slot_flags_pair
description: Clears the busy flag for slot 2 and sets its companion flag, or does the same for the first slot when the index differs, then clears the common busy flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:093A
name: reset_slot_flags
description: Clears the first slot's busy flag, sets its companion flag, and clears the common busy flag. Only these three flags are touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0954
name: call_helpers_then_clear_status
description: Calls two helper routines back to back and then clears a global status flag. The referenced text is stray bytes, not a message.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0964
name: clear_slot_flag_store_record
description: Sets the record's first word to one, clears a status flag chosen by the record's index field, then copies the register inputs into the record and zeroes its final word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:097E
name: clear_indexed_flag_store_record
description: Clears one status flag selected by an index of 2, 3 or 4 (the first flag otherwise), then writes the register inputs into the record with its first word set to one and its last word zeroed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0990
name: clear_pair_flag_store_record
description: Clears one of two status flags depending on whether the index equals 2, then stores the register inputs in the record with its first word set to one and its last word zeroed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:09A4
name: clear_status_flag_store_record
description: Clears a single status flag and stores the register inputs in the record, setting its first word to one and its last word to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:09AA
name: store_regs_to_record
description: Writes four word inputs and one long input into a record addressed by an address register, setting its first word to one and its final word to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:09C8
name: write_channel_regs_if_free
description: Clears the record's status fields when the selected audio channel is busy. When the channel is free, it copies two stored words into that channel's period and volume hardware registers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:09CE
name: set_audio_channel_data
description: Checks the busy flag of the audio channel chosen by the record's index. If the channel is free, it writes the record's two stored words to that channel's period and volume registers, otherwise it clears the record's status fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0ABE
name: reset_state_block_and_tables
description: Clears a block of 136 words, then when the selector is nonzero copies four longs from a lookup table chosen by it and points eight state slots at the cleared block. It then stores small constants into slot fields, resets two flags, and calls a helper when the selector equals ten.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0AC2
name: reset_state_block_alt_entry
description: Second entry point into the state reset body: the decompiled code matches the preceding routine (clear a 136-word block, load table values, point eight slots at it, reset flags, call a helper when the selector is ten).

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0AC6
name: reset_state_block_entry_two
description: Another entry point into the same state reset body, which clears the 136-word block, loads a table selected by the selector, points eight slots at it, resets flags and calls a helper for selector ten.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0ACA
name: reset_state_block_entry_three
description: Entry point that falls into the shared state reset body: it clears a 136-word block, loads table values for a nonzero selector, points eight slots at the block, resets flags, and calls a helper for selector ten.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0AE2
name: reset_state_block_entry_four
description: Entry point into the shared state reset body. It clears a 136-word block, loads table values for a nonzero selector, points eight slots at the block, resets flags, and calls a helper for selector ten.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0AE6
name: reset_state_block_entry_five
description: Entry point into the shared state reset body: clears a 136-word block, loads table values for a nonzero selector, points eight slots at the block, resets flags, and calls a helper when the selector equals ten.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0AEA
name: reset_state_block_entry_six
description: Another entry point into the shared state reset body. It clears a 136-word block, loads table values for a nonzero selector, points eight slots at the block, resets flags, and calls a helper for selector ten.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0AFA
name: reset_state_block_entry_seven
description: Entry point into the shared state reset body with the same visible code: clears a 136-word block, loads a table entry for a nonzero selector, points eight slots at the block, resets flags, and calls a helper for selector ten.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0C2C
name: update_channel_timers_and_release
description: Runs once per tick: returns early when a stop flag is set, otherwise steps a level counter up or down toward its limit and advances four per-channel countdowns. When a countdown passes 50 ticks and its channel value has dropped below 2, the channel's state is cleared, and helpers are called for each channel whose flag is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0E1C
name: clear_channel_flag_by_index
description: Dispatches on a channel index from 1 to 4, clearing that channel's flag and calling a helper to apply the change. Index values outside that range do nothing.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0F10
name: enable_flag_and_call_helper
description: Sets a global flag to one and then calls one helper routine. No other state is changed here.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0F34
name: reset_channel_state_from_table
description: Calls a helper, clears the state words of each channel whose flag is set, then loads a long from a table indexed by a stored counter and clears that counter and a flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0FB0
name: disable_flag_and_call_helper
description: Clears a global flag to zero and then calls one helper routine. No other state is changed here.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:0FD4
name: enable_audio_channel_zero
description: Sets a global enable flag to one and calls a helper. The facts list the first audio channel's location register as touched, though the code shows only the flag and the call.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:106C
name: enable_flag_and_call_helper
description: Sets a global flag to one and then calls one helper routine. No other state is changed here.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:1090
name: load_table_entry_clear_counter
description: Calls a helper, loads a long from a table at the offset of a stored index, then clears that index and a second variable.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:10BC
name: disable_audio_channel_one
description: Clears a global flag to zero and calls a helper. The facts show the second audio channel's location register as touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:10E0
name: enable_audio_channel_one
description: Sets a global enable flag to one and calls a helper. The facts show the second audio channel's location register as touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:1178
name: enable_flag_and_call_helper
description: Sets a global flag to one and then calls one helper routine. No other state is changed here.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:119C
name: load_table_entry_clear_counter
description: Calls a helper, loads a long from a table at the offset of a stored index, then clears that index and a second variable.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:11C8
name: disable_audio_channel_two
description: Clears a global flag to zero and calls a helper. The facts show the third audio channel's location register as touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:11EC
name: enable_audio_channel_two
description: Sets a global enable flag to one and calls a helper. The facts show the third audio channel's location register as touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:1286
name: enable_flag_and_call_helper
description: Sets a global flag to one and then calls one helper routine. No other state is changed here.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:12AA
name: load_table_entry_clear_counter
description: Calls a helper, loads a long from a table at the offset of a stored index, then clears that index and a second variable.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:12D6
name: disable_audio_channel_three
description: Clears a global flag to zero and calls a helper. The facts show the fourth audio channel's location register as touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:12FA
name: enable_audio_channel_three
description: Sets the enable flag for the fourth audio channel to one and calls one helper routine. The facts list that channel's location register as touched, though the code shows only the flag and the call.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:131E
name: advance_voice_sequence_step
description: Advances one voice's data stream. When its step counter is zero, it reads the next command word (returning on a zero command) and loads the voice's duration, data pointer and parameters; otherwise it counts the step down. It then updates a value stepping toward a target and writes the result to the voice's output fields. The facts list the DMA control register as touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:149E
name: fetch_next_voice_value
description: Reads the next command word from a voice's stream and, when it is nonzero, loads the voice fields from it. It then fetches the next stored value from the stream, subtracting an offset when one is set, and writes it to the output record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:14EE
name: load_voice_stream_and_fetch
description: Reads a count from a voice stream, stores the next stored value in the output record, and subtracts an offset from it when one is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:1574
name: read_voice_command_and_fetch
description: Reads the next command from a voice's pointer stream and, when the command is nonzero, loads the voice fields from it. It then fetches the next stored value into the output record, subtracting an offset when one is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:1586
name: step_voice_command_pointer
description: Steps a voice's command counter down, reads the command word it points to, and when it is nonzero loads the voice fields and fetches the next stored value into the output record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:1594
name: clear_port_bit_load_command
description: Clears bit one (value two) of a shared status byte, then reads the next command and loads the voice fields from it. The facts list the port A control register as touched, and its bits carry the fire buttons and disk status.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:15A0
name: set_port_bit_load_command
description: Sets bit one (value two) of a shared status byte, then reads the next command and loads the voice fields from it. The facts list the port A control register as touched, and its bits carry the fire buttons and disk status.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:15AC
name: load_voice_stream_entry
description: Loads a voice's counter and pointers from a stream entry, reads the entry's command, and when that command is nonzero copies the voice fields and fetches the next stored value into the output record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:15DC
name: next_voice_stream_entry
description: Moves a voice to its next stream pointer, wrapping back to the base when it reaches the end, then reads the command at that pointer and loads the voice fields. A nonzero command also fetches the next stored value into the output record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:15F6
name: load_voice_long_and_fetch
description: Stores the first long word from a voice's stream into a voice field and advances the stream pointer past it. It then reads the command word and, when nonzero, loads the voice fields and fetches the next stored value into the output record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:1604
name: copy_two_longs_load_command
description: Copies two long words from the input block into the voice record, reads the command word that follows, and loads the voice fields when it is nonzero. A nonzero command also fetches the next stored value into the output record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:1610
name: copy_three_longs_load_command
description: Sets the voice's flag word, copies three long words from the input block into the record, then reads the following command and loads the voice fields when it is nonzero. The output record receives the next stored value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:1626
name: clear_voice_field_load_command
description: Clears one field of the voice record, then reads the next command word and loads the voice fields when it is nonzero, fetching the next stored value into the output record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:162E
name: clear_voice_flag_load_command
description: Clears the voice's flag word, then reads the next command word and loads the voice fields when it is nonzero, fetching the next stored value into the output record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:1636
name: clear_channel_flag_for_code
description: For stored codes 5, 6, 7 and 8 it clears the busy flag of the matching audio channel, writing a small temporary constant to a shared variable first. Any other code returns without changing channel flags.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:1658
name: start_audio_channel_zero
description: Writes one and then zero to a shared control variable and clears the first channel's busy flag. The facts list the first channel's period and volume registers and the DMA control register as touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:167C
name: start_audio_channel_one
description: Writes two and then zero to a shared control variable and clears the second channel's busy flag. The facts list the second channel's period and volume registers and the DMA control register as touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:16A0
name: start_audio_channel_two
description: Writes four and then zero to a shared control variable and clears the third channel's busy flag. The facts list the third channel's period and volume registers and the DMA control register as touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:16C4
name: start_audio_channel_three
description: Writes eight and then zero to a shared control variable and clears the fourth channel's busy flag. The facts list the fourth channel's period and volume registers and the DMA control register as touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:16E8
name: stop_audio_channel_zero
description: Writes one and then zero to a shared control variable, with no other state changed. The facts list the first channel's period and volume registers and the DMA control register as touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:1702
name: stop_audio_channel_one
description: Writes two and then zero to a shared control variable, with no other state changed. The facts list the second channel's period and volume registers and the DMA control register as touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:171C
name: stop_audio_channel_two
description: Writes four and then zero to a shared control variable, with no other state changed. The facts list the third channel's period and volume registers and the DMA control register as touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:1736
name: stop_audio_channel_three
description: Writes eight and then zero to a shared control variable, with no other state changed. The facts list the fourth channel's period and volume registers and the DMA control register as touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:1750
name: set_voice_flag_load_command
description: Sets a voice flag word to one, then reads the next command word and loads the voice fields when it is nonzero. A nonzero command also fetches the next stored value into the output record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:1762
name: load_voice_command_from_pointer
description: Takes the next pointer from a voice's pointer list, reads the command word it points to, and when that command is nonzero loads the voice fields and fetches the next stored value into the output record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:26314
name: clear_flag_and_call
description: Clears a byte at an offset from an address register, calls one helper routine, sets a global byte to one, and returns the helper's result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:2632E
name: call_helper_then_set_flag
description: Calls one helper routine, then sets a global flag byte to one and returns the register results from the helper.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:26346
name: find_next_active_table_entry
description: Clears a status bit and, if it was set, calls two helpers. It then scans an eight-entry byte table for the next nonzero entry, starting from a stored position. When it finds one, it records the entry's index plus one and calls a helper.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:263CE
name: set_flag_from_status_zero
description: Sets a flag byte to all ones when a status byte is zero, and to zero otherwise.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:263D2
name: set_flag_from_zero_condition
description: Sets a flag byte to all ones when the processor's zero condition is set, and to zero otherwise.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:3:263D8
name: reset_selector_and_call_helper
description: Sets a stored word to minus one, clears a flag byte and a global flag, sets a selector variable to nine, and calls one helper routine.
